title: Top Motown Albums of All Time: Smokey’s Soul Town Counts Down Your Favorites
summary: Vote now, then tune in to Smokey's Soul Town soon to hear a countdown of songs from the greatest Motown albums.
body_markdown:
What are the greatest Motown albums ever released? Now’s your chance to help decide.


[Smokey’s Soul Town Classic R&B hosted by Smokey Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTagPage-SmokeysSoulTown)


[Smokey’s Soul Town](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/smokeys-soul-town) is asking listeners to vote for the Top Motown Albums of All Time. Browse the list below and cast your vote for up to 10 albums you think deserve a spot in the countdown.


Once the votes are in, tune in to Smokey’s Soul Town on car radios and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogTagPage-SmokeysSoulTown) to hear the Listener-Voted Top Motown Albums of All Time countdown, featuring the albums fans selected as the very best from Motown’s legendary catalog.
